articles.title: Senator Elizabeth Warren accuses U.S. regulator of approving unqualified crypto banks
articles.snippet: The Senate Banking Committee's top Democrat sent a letter to the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency questioning the charters of nine crypto firms.

articles.title: Senator Warren questions OCC chief on approval of ‘ineligible’ crypto trust charters
articles.snippet: The Massachusetts lawmaker asked the US Comptroller of the Currency to provide all communications between the agency and Donald Trump potentially related to the charter approvals.

articles.title: Republican lawmakers call for permanent CBDC ban as House vote approaches
articles.snippet: Tom Emmer, the House majority whip, is also advocating for his Anti-CBDC Surveillance State Act, which has passed the House but has yet to pass the Senate.

articles.title: SEC to make ‘innovation exemption’ for tokenized stock trading: Report
articles.snippet: Several SEC officials reportedly didn’t support the decision, while tokenization platform Securitize flagged risks with enabling third-party platforms to issue tokenized stocks.

articles.title: Bitcoin DeFi Platform Echo Protocol Hit By $76M Monad Exploit
articles.snippet: Echo Protocol said that a compromised admin key had enabled unauthorized eBTC minting on its Monad deployment.
